programme.title: Знаки судьбы
programme.desc: Проект о таинственных знаках судьбы, необычных стечениях обстоятельств и загадочных историях из жизни. Даже самые упрямые реалисты сталкиваются с вещами, которые нельзя объяснить логикой. Знаки судьбы окружают нас повсюду. Чтобы найти к ним путь, нужно увидеть и расшифровать их…

programme.title: Музыка
programme.desc: Музыкальные клипы в эфире телеканала. Новые хиты и временем проверенная "классика" от лучших исполнителей.

programme.title: Погоня за вкусом
programme.desc: Шеф-повар Марк Стаценко и его помощница Ирина Чеснокова одержимы идеей открыть ресторан с волшебным меню, собранным по всему миру. Каждое блюдо будет не только полезным, но и чудесным образом дарить мало того что здоровье, но что важнее – счастье, удачу, красоту и процветание…

programme.title: Новый день
programme.desc: Известный астролог Кали Шанкар поможет героиням найти предназначение, а команда стилистов займется их преображением. Вместе с ТВ-3 они проживут день согласно своему предназначению и решат, следовать ему или нет.

programme.title: Особенности национальной кухни
programme.desc: Михаил Стогниенко вместе со зрителями отправится исследовать Россию такой, какой она бывает далеко за пределами МКАДа. Каждый выпуск станет экспедицией в один из городов, куда вместе с Михаилом отправится иностранный шеф-повар высокой кухни Пьер Карбонара. Они вместе привезут с собой главное гастрономическое сокровище ресторана Пьера — эффектное и дорогое блюдо, за которое в столице отдают тысячи рублей. Сумеют ли жители регионов, привыкшие к сытной кухне, оценить гастрономический изыск? Их первая реакция, честная и без скидок, многое расставит по местам.

programme.title: Твой мир
programme.desc: "Проявив ""излишнюю"" сердобольность, сотрудник банка Артем Воронцов теряет работу. Но на этом ""сюрпризы"" не заканчиваются. На улице к нему подходит загадочный старик. Представившись адвокатом, он сообщает, что покойный дядя завещал Артему антикварную лавку, чем приводит парня в недоумение - выросший в детдоме, он и понятия не имел о существовании дядюшки. Несмотря на это, Артем соглашается принять наследство и вскоре понимает, что магазинчик хранит множество тайн...

programme.title: Секреты здоровья
programme.desc: Медицинский тележурнал, где звёздный врач, психолог, популярный блогер Екатерина Юрьева и обаятельная ведущая Анна Демидович расскажут, как сделать так, чтобы температура всегда равнялась 36,6. В рамках каждого выпуска они рассмотрят волнующую тему о здоровье для всей семьи - например, как коллективно пережить грипп, не заразившись им по цепочке. А ещё в нескольких рубриках дадут рекомендации мамам по уходу за детьми, ответят на самые популярные вопросы зрителей и откроют секрет, как самостоятельно поддерживать самочувствие в норме, уделяя этому всего 15 минут в день.

programme.title: Слепая
programme.desc: Баба Нина – уникальная ведунья, которая уединённо живёт в глуши, но к которой обращаются десятки людей. Эта слепая женщина обладает уникальным даром провидения и может рассказать многое о человеке и его судьбе.

programme.title: Музыка
programme.desc: Музыкальные клипы в эфире телеканала. Новые хиты и временем проверенная "классика" от лучших исполнителей.

programme.title: Неизвестный
programme.desc: "Неизвестный" – новый сериал на ТВ-3 в стилистике классического американского детектива. …Без одежды, без памяти, без алиби… Он бежит по лесу. Но от кого? Слышен вой собак, явно идущих по его следу. Но почему? Еще пара мгновений, и его задерживают. Но в чем он виновен? И, хотя он ничего о себе не помнит, он убежден, что не смог бы обидеть ребенка. Но как убедить в этом полицию? Видимо, самому вычислить преступника.

programme.title: Громкие дела
programme.desc: Громкие преступления – это уголовные дела, катастрофы, гибели знаменитостей, которые потрясли всю страну и оставили за собой шлейф вопросов. Почему? Как? За что? Кто понесет наказание? Самые известные экстрасенсы страны вместе с ведущим Дмитрием Штоколовым начинают беспрецедентные расследования этих дел.

programme.title: Исповедь экстрасенса
programme.desc: Исповедь самых известных экстрасенсов страны. Никогда еще они не открывали своих секретов, каково это обладать даром провидения и знать все наперед. Почему они не могут уберечь своих близких от несчастий, как они проводят обычные будни, и кто из этих сверхлюдей способен на обычные слезы. Герои: Джуна, Мессинг, Багирова, Леденев, Глобы, Кашпировский, Чумак, Галунова, Зулия, Дюваль, Волхов, Данис Глинштейн.

programme.title: Чтец
programme.desc: Лидия приезжает из Петербурга в Москву, чтобы повидаться с сестрой Лизой. Но вместо радостной встречи ее ждут ужасные новости - Лиза была зверски убита. Судя по состоянию квартиры, убийца обладал нечеловеческой силой. Однако Рапопорт уверен - всему есть рациональное объяснение. С помощью своих помощников, он собирается в очередной раз доказать, что разгадка таится именно в человеческих эмоциях.

programme.title: Чтец
programme.desc: Бизнесмен Петр Пашков в отчаянии. Пропал его 8-летний сын Леша. Мальчик считается юным гением и может решать труднейшие математические задачи. Похитители требуют огромный выкуп за Лешу, угрожая убить его, если родители вызовут полицию. Пока Рапопорт пытается понять, что скрывает родная мать Леши, детективы стараются выиграть время, чтобы не позволить вымогателям осуществить свои планы. Но время стремительно уходит.

programme.title: Любовная магия
programme.desc: Гала – специалист по любовной магии. Она помогает людям в большом городе обрести любовь, и не теряет надежды встретить и свое женское счастье. Гала может найти ответ почти на любой вопрос, касающийся отношений, ведь ей дана прозорливость и умение видеть в картах и магическом шаре то, чего другие не видят.

Иногда в окружении появляется тот, кто желает зла настолько, что не остановится ни перед чем. Зависть, ненависть и другие негативные чувства толкают людей к контакту со сверхъестественным. И в нашей жизни наступает черная полоса. Мы задаемся вопросом: почему все валится из рук, преследуют несчастья, болезни и невезение в любви и браке? Ответ на этот вопрос может быть простым, но зловещим: на вас навели порчу. Смотрите онлайн докудраму Порча на телеканале Домашний, в которой герои обращаются к Тамаре - женщине, обладающей сверхъестественными способностями. Она может увидеть, есть ли на человеке отметка тьмы, и помочь отвести беду. В каждом выпуске программы будет воссоздан реальный случай из практики Тамары - когда отчаявшиеся люди обращались к ней за помощью. Тамара расскажет, как узнать, что на вас навели порчу, и что делать, если это действительно произошло. На официальном сайте телеканала Домашний вы можете смотреть онлайн все серии докудрамы Порча в хорошем качестве.

programme.title: Громкие дела
programme.desc: Громкие преступления – это уголовные дела, катастрофы, гибели знаменитостей, которые потрясли всю страну и оставили за собой шлейф вопросов. Почему? Как? За что? Кто понесет наказание? Самые известные экстрасенсы страны вместе с ведущим Дмитрием Штоколовым начинают беспрецедентные расследования этих дел.

programme.title: Исповедь экстрасенса
programme.desc: Исповедь самых известных экстрасенсов страны. Никогда еще они не открывали своих секретов, каково это обладать даром провидения и знать все наперед. Почему они не могут уберечь своих близких от несчастий, как они проводят обычные будни, и кто из этих сверхлюдей способен на обычные слезы. Герои: Джуна, Мессинг, Багирова, Леденев, Глобы, Кашпировский, Чумак, Галунова, Зулия, Дюваль, Волхов, Данис Глинштейн.

programme.title: Музыка
programme.desc: Музыкальные клипы в эфире телеканала. Новые хиты и временем проверенная "классика" от лучших исполнителей.

programme.title: Ātrās reaģēšanas vienība
programme.desc: Losandželosas policijas departamenta Speciālo uzdevumu vienības komandai notiek treniņš pamestā lidostas angārā. Tomēr notiek neparedzētais, un visa komanda nonāk lamatās pret divām konkurējošām mafijas bandām, kas abas cīnās par kādu retu un vērtīgu priekšmetu. Ieslodzīti pamestā angārā un bruņoti tikai ar tukšām lodēm, vienības kaujinieki ir neapskaužamā situācijā.

programme.title: Lietiskie pierādījumi
programme.desc: Krimināli dokumentāls drāmas seriāls, kurā tiek izmeklēti sarežģīti kriminālprocesi. Katra sērija ir atsevišķs stāsts, kas balstīts uz reāliem notikumiem. Daudzi šādi noziegumi varētu palikt neatklāti un vainīgais – izvairīties no soda, ja vien izmeklētāja atklātā detaļa nekļūtu par pavedienu uz atrisinājumu: nomesta matu sprādze, pazaudēta poga vai ielikta zīmīte - lietiskie pierādījumi.

programme.title: Draudzenes Parīzē
programme.desc: Elegantā, romantiskā un krāšņā mīlestības galvaspilsēta Parīze atvilinājusi sešas jaunas amerikānietes apmesties šeit uz dzīvi. Anja, Emīlija, Margo, Keisija, Adja un Viktorija ir draudzenes, kuras piepilda sapni par Parīzi, pat ja tas ne vienmēr ir rozēm kaisīts, un ar piedzīvoto drosmīgi dalās arī ar skatītājiem. Vai viegli iekarot parīziešu sirdis, ko darīt, ja karjerā nesokas kā pa diedziņu, kā sadzīvot ar mentalitātes atšķirībām? Meitenes atklāti dalīsies ikdienā piedzīvotajā, izkratīs viena otrai sirdi un kopā priecāsies par sasniegumiem mīlā un karjerā.

programme.title: Romeo un Džuljeta no Čerkasiem
programme.desc: Roma un Jūlija ir iemīlējušies un vēlas apprecēties, taču abu vecāki ir šausmās! Izrādās, viņi ir ienaidnieki jau kopš skolas laikiem. Protams, bērnu vārdā četrotne sola aprakt kara cirvi un sarīkot pasakainas kāzas. Taču senos aizvainojumus nav nemaz tik viegli aizmirst. Roma un Jūlija dara visu, lai kāzas noritētu saticīgā gaisotnē, taču pat nenojauš, ka viņu centieni salabināt savus vecākus nesīs negaidītu rezultātu. Sievastēvs iemīlas valdonīgajā znota mātē, savukārt romantiskā vīramāte iecerējusi pārvākties pie znota tēva. Ieilgusī spriedze pārvērš gatavošanos kāzām īstā haosā. Vai ilgi gaidītās kāzas maz notiks? Un kurš tad īsti apprecēsies?

programme.title: Cipars vai ģerbonis
programme.desc: "Galvas un astes" - iecienītākais ceļojumu šovs dažādu seju, dzimumu un vecumu ceļotājiem. Viena pilsēta un divi vadītāji. Bet vienam no viņiem ir simts dolāru, kas paredzēti visām izklaidēm, bet otram ir zelta bankas karte. Tas ir monētas metiens. Jūs esat miljonārs vai nabags. Jūs dzīvojat greznā dzīvoklī vai guļat hostelī. Jūs pusdienojat augstas klases restorānā vai paēdat pieticīgā ātrās ēdināšanas ēstuvē. Taču zelta karte nenozīmē neaizmirstamas brīvdienas. Dažkārt pietiek pat ar simts dolāriem, lai ceļojums būtu neaizmirstams uz visiem laikiem.

programme.title: Pacific Rim: Uzbrukums Zemei
programme.desc: Kad no okeāna dzīlēm iznirst briesmīgie kaijū, aizsākas bezgalīgs karš, kas paņem miljoniem cilvēku dzīvības un aprij visus cilvēces resursus. Cīņai ar milzīgajiem kaijū izveido īpašus ieročus - milzu robotus, ko dēvē par jēgeriem. Tos sinhroni vada divi piloti, kuru prāti ir saslēgti neironu saitē. Tomēr pat jēgeri šķiet bezspēcīgi nerimstošo kaijū priekšā. Kad sagrāve jau šķiet neizbēgama, cilvēces aizstāvjiem nekas neatliek, kā vērsties pēc palīdzības pie kāda bijušā pilota un nepārbaudīta mācekļa, kuriem kopā būs jāvada šķietami novecojis pagātnes jēgers. Kopā viņi ir pēdējā cilvēces cerība paglābties no apokalipses.

programme.title: Troļļi
programme.desc: Troļļu pilsētā valda prieks un spožums, un Popija atklāj ko patiesi pārsteidzošu – izrādās, kaimiņos ir vēl vairākas Troļļu pasaules! Katra no tām ir veltīta kādam muzikālajam žanram. Kad noslēpumains drauds uzglūn visai Troļļu saimei, Popija, Zars un viņu draugi dosies cauri nepazīstamām zemēm, lai paveiktu ko šķietami neiespējamu: apvienotu visus Troļļus un šajā harmonijā stātos pretī ļaundarim.

programme.title: Zirnekļcilvēks: Atgriešanās mājās
programme.desc: Sajūsmināts par pavadīto laiku kopā ar Atriebējiem, Pīters Pārkers ir atgriezies mājās, kur dzīvo kopā ar tanti Meju sava jaunā mentora Tonija Stārka uzraudzībā. Viņš cenšas dzīvot vienkāršu pusaudža dzīvi, tomēr nespēj nedomāt par to, ka varētu būt sabiedrībai noderīgs ar savām supervaroņa spējām. Kad pie apvāršņa parādās ļaundaris, viņam būs iespēja tās likt lietā!

programme.title: RED aģenti
programme.desc: Atvaļinātais CIP aģents Frenks Mozess kopā ar savu pārsteidzošo elites spiegu komandu dodas meklēt pazudušu kodolieroču kontrolēšanas ierīci. Lai atrastu to, viņiem būs jātiek galā ar neatlaidīgiem slepkavām, nežēlīgiem teroristiem un varaskāriem valdības pārstāvjiem, kuri vēlas iegūt jaunākās paaudzes ieroci. Meklējumu laikā Frenks un viņa kolēģi nonāks Parīzē, Londonā un Maskavā. Mēģinot izglābt pasauli, atvaļinātie aģenti stāsies pretī ievērojamam pārspēkam. Lai izdzīvotu, viņi var paļauties tikai viens uz otru.

programme.title: Barijs Sīls: Īstens amerikānis
programme.desc: Stāsts par Bariju Sīlu, amerikāņu lidmašīnas pilotu, kurš iefiltrējās narkotiku kartelī CIP slepena uzdevuma ietvaros 20. gs. 80. gados, kas tiek atmaskots kā pret Irānu vērsta militāra operācija.

programme.title: Smalkā zviedru māksla ieviest kārtību pirms nāves
Superomīte
programme.desc: Nav noslēpums, ka vecmāmiņai ir būtiska loma mazbērnu audzināšanā, dažkārt pat pārāk iesaistoties mammai paredzētajos pienākumos. Taču nevajadzētu aizmirst, ka tieši mamma ir galvenā savu bērnu dzīvē, veidojot viņu personību un tālāko likteni. Šajā projektā tiks parādītas atšķirīgās mammas un vecmāmiņas lomas bērnu un mazbērnu audzināšanā, atklājot, kura patiesībā ieņem nozīmīgāku vietu nākamās paaudzes dzīvē. Turklāt šis realitātes šovs lauzīs visus stereotipus par to, ka vecmāmiņas var tikai sēdēt uz soliņiem pie ieejas, apspriest kaimiņus vai pavadīt laiku, skatoties kārtējo seriālu. Katrā jaunā epizodē piedalās trīs ģimenes paaudzes, un tās ir pašas vecmāmiņas – galvenās varones –, viņu bērni, kas jau kļuvuši par vecākiem, un mazbērni. Tas ir īsts vairāku paaudžu stāsts, kurā skatītājs varēs vērot, kā vecmāmiņa, vēl būdama māte, audzinājusi savus bērnus un kā tagad tas var ietekmēt viņas mazbērnus.

programme.title: Nekā deklarējama: Austrālija
programme.desc: Nedeklarētas lietas, aizliegtas vielas, mēģinājumi nelegāli iebraukt valstī, svešu cilvēku pases, aizdomīgi sūtījumi - tā ir robežkontroles darbinieku ikdiena. Viņu uzdevums ir identificēt un novērst noziedzīgas darbības - konfiscēt narkotikas, ieročus un citas aizliegtas lietas, neielaist valstī noziedzniekus un cilvēkus, kuri varētu mēģināt nelegāli uzturēties Austrālijā.

programme.title: Nosusini okeānu
programme.desc: Izmantojot jaunākās sonāra tehnoloģijas, unikālā ekspedīcijā, lai kartētu Normandijas piekrastē nogrimušos sabiedroto kuģus, atklājas pārsteidzoši attēli zem viļņiem. Lamanša šaurumā atrodas vairāk nekā simts desanta kuģi un citi kuģi, kuri peldēja vēsturē lielākajā invāzijas flotē. Kad ūdens notek, mēs atklājam neparastas, slepenas tehnoloģijas, ko gan sabiedrotie, gan nacisti izmantoja cīņā par Rietumeiropu. Šī konflikta iznākums uz visiem laikiem izmaina mūsu pasauli.

programme.title: Elementāri, Vatson!
programme.desc: Izmeklēšanas seriāla "Elementāri, Vatson" jaunā sezona ir cieši saistīta ar trešās sezonas beigu notikumiem. Tikai viena vājība - narkotiku atkarība. Šerloks Holmss pie tās atgriezās vai, pareizāk sakot, tika izprovocēts atgriezties, kad Holmsam pazīstamais narkomāns Oskars Renkins nolaupīja viņa draugu Alfredo. Vatsone ar policistiem Alfredo izglāba, bet tikmēr Šerloks pastrādāja to, ko labot vairs nebija iespējams - uzbruka Renkinam un atkal ķērās pie narkotikām. Tagad Šerloks Holmss ir atstādināts no policijas konsultanta amata un viņam draud cietumsods par nopietnu miesas bojājumu nodarīšanu. Un tomēr… Ir kāds cilvēks, kurš var slaveno izmeklētāju izglābt, un tas ir viņa ietekmīgais un bagātais tēvs. Šerloks Holmss gan netic, ka viņš tiešām varētu ierasties, tomēr šoreiz tas tiešām notiks - Holmss seniors ieradīsies un spēlēs visnotaļ nopietnu lomu visā seriāla ceturtajā sezonā. Vai Holmss un Vatsone atgriezīsies darbā policijā un kādos neceļos abus lieliskos izmeklētājus aizvedīs jaunās lietas, skatieties seriāla ceturtajā sezonā!

programme.title: Cipars vai ģerbonis
programme.desc: "Galvas un astes" - iecienītākais ceļojumu šovs dažādu seju, dzimumu un vecumu ceļotājiem. Viena pilsēta un divi vadītāji. Bet vienam no viņiem ir simts dolāru, kas paredzēti visām izklaidēm, bet otram ir zelta bankas karte. Tas ir monētas metiens. Jūs esat miljonārs vai nabags. Jūs dzīvojat greznā dzīvoklī vai guļat hostelī. Jūs pusdienojat augstas klases restorānā vai paēdat pieticīgā ātrās ēdināšanas ēstuvē. Taču zelta karte nenozīmē neaizmirstamas brīvdienas. Dažkārt pietiek pat ar simts dolāriem, lai ceļojums būtu neaizmirstams uz visiem laikiem.

programme.title: Romeo un Džuljeta no Čerkasiem
programme.desc: Roma un Jūlija ir iemīlējušies un vēlas apprecēties, taču abu vecāki ir šausmās! Izrādās, viņi ir ienaidnieki jau kopš skolas laikiem. Protams, bērnu vārdā četrotne sola aprakt kara cirvi un sarīkot pasakainas kāzas. Taču senos aizvainojumus nav nemaz tik viegli aizmirst. Roma un Jūlija dara visu, lai kāzas noritētu saticīgā gaisotnē, taču pat nenojauš, ka viņu centieni salabināt savus vecākus nesīs negaidītu rezultātu. Sievastēvs iemīlas valdonīgajā znota mātē, savukārt romantiskā vīramāte iecerējusi pārvākties pie znota tēva. Ieilgusī spriedze pārvērš gatavošanos kāzām īstā haosā. Vai ilgi gaidītās kāzas maz notiks? Un kurš tad īsti apprecēsies?

programme.title: Bruņinieka stāsts
programme.desc: Viljams ir jauns zemnieku puisis, kuram piemīt talants un dotības, lai piedalītos bruņinieku turnīrā. Vienīgais, kas viņu kavē, ir necilā izcelsme. Pēc tam kad mirst viņa skolotājs, Viljams kopā ar diviem draugiem dodas klaiņojumos pa pasauli. Ceļā viņi nejauši iepazīstas ar mazpazīstamu rakstnieku, kurš ir ar mieru viltot radurakstus. Ar šiem dokumentiem kabatā Viljams ir gatavs pierādīt sevi valsts bruņinieku turnīrā. Protams, neiztikt arī bez romantiskiem piedzīvojumiem.

programme.title: Lietiskie pierādījumi
programme.desc: Krimināli dokumentāls drāmas seriāls, kurā tiek izmeklēti sarežģīti kriminālprocesi. Katra sērija ir atsevišķs stāsts, kas balstīts uz reāliem notikumiem. Daudzi šādi noziegumi varētu palikt neatklāti un vainīgais – izvairīties no soda, ja vien izmeklētāja atklātā detaļa nekļūtu par pavedienu uz atrisinājumu: nomesta matu sprādze, pazaudēta poga vai ielikta zīmīte - lietiskie pierādījumi.

programme.title: Ārpus kartes
programme.desc: Toms Holands, Marks Valbergs un Antonio Banderass piedzīvojumu filmā, kas balstīta uz populāro videospēli Uncharted. Neitans Dreiks kopā ar savu partneri Salliju dodas savās pirmajās dārgumu medībās. Šīs dārgumu medības aizved draugus bīstamā piedzīvojumā uz vistālākajiem pasaules nostūriem dižākajiem un nekad neatrastajiem dārgumiem pa pēdām, vienlaikus sekojot norādēm, kas varētu palīdzēt atrast Neita sen pazudušo brāli.

programme.title: Rēgu bruņinieks
programme.desc: Lai glābtu savu mirstošo tēvu, jaunais motociklu triku meistars Džonijs Bleizs pārdod savu dvēseli Mefistofelim un izšķiras no savas mūža mīlestības Roksanas Simpsones. Pēc dažiem gadiem, kad Džonijs kļuvis par valstī slavenu motošova zvaigzni, viņa ceļi atkal krustojas gan ar Roksanu, gan Mefistofeli, kurš sola atbrīvot Džonija dvēseli ar vienu nosacījumu. Džonijam jākļūst par Rēgu bruņinieku un jāpilda soģa pienākumi. Tomēr, kas reiz parakstījis vienošanos ar Mefistofeli, tam dzīve vairs nekad nebūs tāda, kā agrāk.

programme.title: Adeles neparastie piedzīvojumi
programme.desc: Parīze, 1912. gads. Pilsētu pārņem panika, jo no Parīzes Dabas vēstures muzeja 136 miljonus gadu vecās olas ir izšķīlies un pār pilsētu sācis lidot īsts pterozaurs. Tikmēr bezbailīgā un šarmantā žurnāliste, ceļotāja Adela dodas pati savā pārdrošajā misijā. Viņa ir gatava mērot ceļu līdz pat Ēģiptei, lai uzmeklētu faraona Ramzesa II personīgā ārsta mumificētās mirstīgās atliekas. Adelas mērķis nav vis slava vai dārgumi, bet gan izmisīgs glābšanas plāns — viņa tic, ka ar ekscentriska profesora palīdzību spēs atdzīvināt mūmiju, kuras senās medicīnas zināšanas ir vienīgā cerība izglābt viņas smagi slimo māsu. Taču, atgriežoties Parīzē, Adela attopas mistisku, komisku un neticamu notikumu epicentrā, kur pterozaura medības, valdības intrigas un senās pasaules noslēpumi savijas vienā lielā, krāšņā piedzīvojumā.

programme.title: Cilvēks uz dzegas
programme.desc: Bijušais policists Niks Kesidijs, kurš netaisnīgi notiesāts uz 25 gadiem cietumā par neeksistējoša, neprātīgi dārga dimanta zādzību, izmanto pirmo izdevību, lai izbēgtu no ieslodzījuma. Viņa ceļš ved uz Manhetenas luksusa viesnīcu, kur Niks uzkāpj uz 21. stāva loga dzegas un draud nolēkt, piesaistot visas Ņujorkas uzmanību, medijus un policiju. Kamēr pieredzējusī sarunu vedēja Lidija Mersere cenšas atturēt Niku no liktenīgā soļa un saprast viņa motīvus, lejā pulcējas simtiem ziņkārīgo. Taču šķietamais pašnāvības mēģinājums ir tikai perfekti izplānots aizsegs. Kamēr visas pilsētas acis ir pievērstas vīram uz dzegas, pāri ielai Nika brālis un viņa draudzene uzsāk gadsimta pārdrošāko laupīšanu, lai atrastu it kā nozagto dimantu un pierādītu Nika nevainību. Pulkstenis tikšķ, un viena kļūda var maksāt dzīvību.

programme.title: Policijas akadēmija
programme.desc: Pilsēta nonākusi ielenkumā! Negantu noziedznieku banda apdraud pilsētniekus un tradicionālās policijas metodes pret viņiem ir bezspēcīgas. Šajā situācijā palīgā tiek saukti neparastiem talantiem apveltītie Policijas akadēmijas absolventi, Lasāra audzēkņi, kuri gatavi uz vistrakākajiem un pārdrošākajiem soļiem, lai aizsargātu pilsētu un tās iedzīvotājus. Galvenajās lomās: Baba Smits, Maikls Vinslovs, Deivids Grāfs.

programme.title: Taksis
programme.desc: Taksists Daniels ka viesulis nesas pa Marseļas ielām un ar savu pārgalvīgo braukšanas stilu baida gan pasažierus, gan kājāmgājējus. Viņa iemaņas netiek nepamanītas, policists Emiljens piespiež viņu palīdzēt noķert laupītāju bandu, jo profesionāļu aprindās nav neviena tik pārgalvīga auto braucēja kā Daniels, un tieši šī prasme ir nepieciešama, lai tiktu galā ar neliešiem.

programme.title: Māsa uzdarbojas 2: Atgriešanās
programme.desc: Klostera priekšniece nolemj, ka klostera skolā novārtā atstāta muzikālā audzināšana, un māsa Mērija būs īstā, kura šo caurumu aizlāpīs. Kolorītā dāma kļūst par mūzikas skolotāju tīņu baram, kuriem mūzika interesē tieši tik, cik melns aiz naga, bet māsa Mērija ir sīkstāka nekā jauniešiem var likties. Viņa nepadodas un beigu galā skolēni ir patiesi laimīgi, kad izrādās, ka viņi var TĀ dziedāt - sev un pašiem par prieku. Galvenajā lomā VūpijaGoldberga.

programme.title: Rēgu bruņinieks
programme.desc: Lai glābtu savu mirstošo tēvu, jaunais motociklu triku meistars Džonijs Bleizs pārdod savu dvēseli Mefistofelim un izšķiras no savas mūža mīlestības Roksanas Simpsones. programme.title: Policijas akadēmija
programme.desc: Kad Maskavas iedzīvotāju drošību un mieru sāk apdraudēt mafija, Krievijas valdība palīgā sauc labākos - Policijas akadēmijas veterānus! Pēdējās veiksmīgās misijas iedvesmots, Lasārs daudz nedomā - viņš sapulcē komandu, un visi dodas nezināmajā. Maskavā valda aukstums un pavisam citi likumi - vai krietnajiem likumsargiem izdosies palīdzēt kolēģiem tikt galā ar mafiju? Galvenajās lomās: Maikls Vinslovs, Deivids Grāfs, Džordžs Geinss.

programme.title: Caur ērkšķiem uz...
programme.desc: Pie skatītājiem ar skaudriem dzīvesstāstiem un cerībām par labāku nākotni atgriežas sociālais projekts "Caur ērkšķiem uz..."! Arī septītās sezonas dalībnieces liktenis nav žēlojis - nespēja tikt galā ar atkarībām no alkohola un narkotikām, vardarbība un atņemtas bērnu aprūpes tiesības ir tikai dažas no grūtībām, ar kurām dalībnieces saskaras. Palīdzīgu roku jaunas dzīves sākumam sniegs pieredzējuši profesionāļi un ilggadējais raidījuma vadītājs Jānis Bukums, kā arī TV ekrānā atgriežas raidījuma vadītāja Liene Stepena!

programme.title: Taksis
programme.desc: Taksists Daniels traucas pa Marseļas ielām tādā ātrumā, ka viņam līdzi netiek pat profesionāli autobraucēji, autorallija Parīze-Dakāra uzvarētāji! Kad tiek nolaupīts izrādās Japānas vēstnieks, kas atbraucis pārbaudīt policijas darbu, neviens cits kā tikai Daniels spēs tikt galā ar uzdevumu izglābt gan vēstnieku, gan pilsētas policijas godu! Galvenajās lomās: Semijs Naseri, Frederiks Dīfentāls, Emma Viklunda

programme.title: Ķīlnieka krēslā
programme.desc: Bijušais hakeris Fraiers nonāk neapskaužamā situācijā. Zem viņa krēsla ir novietots spridzeklis, un anonīms ļaundaris, draudot nolaupīt Fraiera meitu, piespiež viņu ielauzties banku informācijas sistēmās, lai veiktu vērienīgu laupīšanu. Policija ir viņam uz pēdām, notikuma vietā ierodas atmīnēšanas eksperti, minūtes rit, un Fraieram laika, lai pierādītu, ka viņš nav īstais vainīgais, paliek arvien mazāk.Galvenajās lomās: Mels Gibsons, Šenona Dohertija, Kevins Dilons

programme.title: Pasaki to skaļi
programme.desc: "Pasaki to skaļi" 5. sezonā vadītāja krēslu līdzās Elīnai Fīrmanei uz laiku ieņems TV personība Roberto Meloni. Roberto ir ļoti iepriecināts un gandarīts, ka var vadīt viņaprāt sirsnīgāko un emocionālāko TV raidījumu ar tik lielu virsvērtību kā pateicība! Arī šajā sezonā satiksim interesantus cilvēkus, lai uzklausītu viņu stāstus un paldies vārdus kādiem īpašiem cilvēkam, dzīves skolotājiem vai vecākiem un, cerams, tie iedvesmo arī mūsu skatītājus teikt vairāk pateicības vārdus skaļi.

programme.title: Pasaki to skaļi
programme.desc: "Pasaki to skaļi" studijā valdīs ļoti sirsnīga noskaņa un, kā atzīs studijas viesis aktieris Andris Bulis, tik atklātās un dziļās sarunās vēl nevienam viņu nav izdevies aizvest. Andris dalīsies savās bērnības sajūtās, kad piedzīvoja vientulību, atklās, par ko dziļi pateicīgs savai sieviņai Ilzei un par ko piedošanu lūdzis savam dēlam. Kārtīgu humora dzirksti studijā ienesīs Daugavpils teātra aktieris, Andra draugs Māris Korsietis, kurš atklās abu draugu piedzīvojumus un aizkustinošus brīžus, par kuriem joprojām Māris ir pateicīgs Andrim.

programme.title: Nezūdošais ļaunums: Laipni lūgti Rakūnsitijā
programme.desc: Rakūnsitija reiz bija plaukstoša farmācijas lieluzņēmuma "Umbrella" mītnes vieta, bet tagad ir panīkusi pilsētele. Uzņēmuma aiziešana pilsētu padarījusi par pamestu vietu zemes virsū, bet zem tās virskārtas perinās ļaunums. Kad tas tiek atbrīvots, grupiņai izdzīvojušo ir jāsadarbojas, lai atklātu patiesību par "Umbrella" un dzīvi sagaidītu rītu. Galvenajās lomās: Kaja Skodelario, Hanna Džona-Kamena, Robijs Amels.

programme.title: Pasaki to skaļi
programme.desc: Šis vakars paies ļoti siltā, sirsnīgā un viedā sarunā, jo Elīna Fīrmane un Roberto Meloni uz sarunu aicinājuši Jaunā Rīgas teātra aktieri Vili Daudziņu. Saruna izdevās tik īpaša un atklāta, iespējams, tādēļ, ka tā notika mākslinieka dzimšanas dienā. Vilis runāja gan par savu ģimeni, gan teātri, gan jauniem sevis meklējumiem. Vilim pateicību gribēja teikt vairāki viņa kolēģi, bet šoreiz šis gods tika viņa jaunajam kolēģim Dāvidam Pētersonam. Abus aktierus, kā izrādās, saista savstarpēja iedvesmošana. Par ko ir šī pateicība un kādi privātās dzīves momenti atstājuši pēdas Viļa dzīvē, uzzināsim raidījumā.

programme.title: Pasaki to skaļi

programme.title: Citādā pasaule
programme.desc: Nepālas ceļojums var sākties! Jau pirmajā sērijā dosimies uz visnotaļ bīstamu savvaļas vietu - Nepālas džungļiem, kur pārsteigumi gaida ik uz soļa! Raidījumā uzzināsiet, kā izvērtīsies saldās medus medības pie milzu asinskārajām bitēm un kā ar masveidīgu rituālu palīdzību iespējams apturēt sausumu, kā arī dosimies uz grandiozām svinībām Himalajos. Bet Dmitrijs Komarovs būs liecinieks nežēlīgam rituālam, kas šokēs līdz sirds dziļumiem. Kāpēc cilvēki joprojām upurē dievus, lūdzot viņiem aizsardzību un palīdzību? To uzzini piedzīvojumiem bagātajā un ekstrēmajā Nepālas ceļojumā!

programme.title: Citādā pasaule
programme.desc: Nepālas ceļojums var sākties! Jau pirmajā sērijā dosimies uz visnotaļ bīstamu savvaļas vietu - Nepālas džungļiem, kur pārsteigumi gaida ik uz soļa! Raidījumā uzzināsiet, kā izvērtīsies saldās medus medības pie milzu asinskārajām bitēm un kā ar masveidīgu rituālu palīdzību iespējams apturēt sausumu, kā arī dosimies uz grandiozām svinībām Himalajos. Bet Dmitrijs Komarovs būs liecinieks nežēlīgam rituālam, kas šokēs līdz sirds dziļumiem. Kāpēc cilvēki joprojām upurē dievus, lūdzot viņiem aizsardzību un palīdzību? To uzzini piedzīvojumiem bagātajā un ekstrēmajā Nepālas ceļojumā!

programme.title: Radu būšana
programme.desc: Maša un Maksims atkal dodas prom - šoreiz uz Nīderlendi, atstājot nu jau septiņus gadus veco Žeņu Mašas vecāku - priecīgo lauku ļaužu - uzraudzībā. Tomēr nepaiet ne diena, kad ciemā ierodas arī smalkie un vīzdegunīgie Maksima vecāki - viņi vēlas mīļoto mazmeitiņu sagatavot skolai, kā arī nedomā pieļaut, ka Mašas vecāki saņems Žeņas nedalītu uzmanību. Žeņa ir jau pietiekoši liela, lai saprastu - šīs vasaras galvenais uzdevums būs uzturēt mieru mājās. Vai mazai meitenei izdosies šķietami neiespējamais - samierināt nesamierināmos?

programme.title: Lietiskie pierādījumi
programme.desc: Krimināli dokumentāls drāmas seriāls, kurā tiek izmeklēti sarežģīti kriminālprocesi. Katra sērija ir atsevišķs stāsts, kas balstīts uz reāliem notikumiem. Daudzi šādi noziegumi varētu palikt neatklāti un vainīgais – izvairīties no soda, ja vien izmeklētāja atklātā detaļa nekļūtu par pavedienu uz atrisinājumu: nomesta matu sprādze, pazaudēta poga vai ielikta zīmīte - lietiskie pierādījumi.

programme.title: Kāpostu zupa
programme.desc: Luijs de Finess komēdijā par vienkāršu fermeru sastapšanos ar citplanētiešiem. Divi padzīvojuši francūžu fermeri savas dienas vada klusi un mierīgi savās vecajās, nelielajās lauku mājās. Klods ir atraitnis, bet Frānsiss ir vientuļnieks. Viņi dienas pavada, izdzerot litriem vīna un atceroties senos, labos laikos. Kādu vakaru viņi sāk piršanas sacīkstes, kas, tā vien šķiet, izraisa negaisu ar zibeni. Piedevām viņi ir pievērsuši sev ārpuszemes iedzīvotāju uzmanību ar savām izpausmēm, un tas mainīs veco fermeru dzīves uz visiem laikiem.

programme.title: KODS
programme.desc: Ieskaties noziedzības pasaulē, kur divas leģendāras komandas no seriāliem "Ūdens policija" un "Izmeklēšanas aģentūra "SLED"" apvieno spēkus, lai izmeklētu vissarežģītākos noziegumus. Šī pieredzes, zināšanu un tehnoloģiju apvienošanās kļūs par īstu izaicinājumu noziedzīgajai pasaulei. Stāsts sākas ar izmeklēšanu par vairākām skaļām ārvalstu pilsoņu slepkavībām, kas vienlaikus notikušas Karpatu reģionā un Kijevā. Vēstnieki un konsuli pieprasīja nekavējoties savervēt labākos spēkus. Detektīviem darbā palīdzēs jaudīga uz mākslīgā intelekta bāzes veidota datorprogramma K.O.D. Tā ne tikai risina sarežģītas noziedznieku mīklas, bet arī nolasa izmeklēšanas dalībnieku emocionālo stāvokli.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: Exploring the lives and careers of the well-known and famous from the worlds of music and film, these 26-minute long biographical portraits provide a pictorial insight into the background, careers and personal lives of some of the twentieth-century's best known personalities and iconic faces.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: The Inspectors
programme.desc: The series stars Jessica Lundy as a United States Postal Inspection Service who investigates crimes relating to United States Postal Service mail. The show also focuses on her personal life as a single mom with a son who became a paraplegic in the same crash that killed his father, also a postal inspector. At the end of each episode, Lundy and the Chief U.S. Postal Inspector, Guy Cottrell, give viewers tips on how to avoid being a victim of a scam similar to the episode.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 2: Snapshot
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey's latest case has her trying to figure out who killed her best friend Barbara after she was left out of her family's will and every one of the family members become suspects.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 3: Sing Me A Murder
programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 4: Vision Of A Murder
programme.desc: Sam lands a job photographing a new spa in Southern California for their brochure and brings her best friend Cassie along to enjoy some pampering. When one of the guests staying at the upscale retreat turns up dead, Sam is once again on the trail of a murderer. As the investigation progresses, Sam uncovers a scam that the spa Dr was testing unapproved drugs on the patrons.. filler implants, etc. without the patients' informed consent.

programme.title: Mayflower Madam
programme.desc: Inspired by the explosive sex-for-sale scandal that rocked Manhattan in 1984, the infamous Sydney Biddle Barrows, a driven young socialite, opens an exclusive escort service catering to the wealthy and affluent. From Sydney's rise to become a million-dollar, modern-day madam to her notorious plummet into bankruptcy and public disgrace, experience a private glimpse into the forbidden world of high-class prostitution-where money talks...pleasure sells...and discretion is everything.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Epic four-hour series about the rise of Octavius who succeeds Julius Caesar and tangles with Marc Anthony for control of the Roman empire and finally went on to become the emperor Augustus.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Marc Antony addresses the crowd at Caesar's funeral, where a shroud hides the deceased leader's stab wounds. Octavius' mother, Atia, recently imprisoned by Cassius, is allowed to speak at Caesar's funeral, but she tells the wild crowd that her son is Caesar's true heir. Meanwhile Camane, the psychic vestal virgin, has put her own life at risk by guarding the will, and Tyrannus, fearing for Octavius' life, once again takes the young heir away from the turbulence of Rome.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Camane posts signs around Rome claiming that Octavius is Caesar's rightful heir. Under Tyrannus's protection Octavius is on the run because Cassius wishes him dead. The two are captured by mercenaries and put into a gladiator's prison where they will face certain death if their true identities are revealed.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Epic four-hour series about the rise of Octavius who succeeds Julius Caesar and tangles with Marc Anthony for control of the Roman empire and finally went on to become the emperor Augustus.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Camane, the beautiful Vestal Virgin, saves Octavius' life after he is bitten by a poisonous snake. When Marc Antony's soldiers arrive suddenly to assassinate Octavius, Camane puts herself in harm's way so the young Emperor can escape and hopefully claim his throne.

programme.title: Empire
programme.desc: Octavius relinquishes the beautiful Vestal Virgin, Camane, so that he can devote himself to being the Emperor of Rome. Tyrannus, the former slave and gladiator, joins Octavius' forces in their fight against the power-hungry Marc Antony, with the fate of Rome and the western world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: Word of Honor
programme.desc: A corporate exec and family man is accused of participating in a war crime 30 years earlier during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The Diplomat
programme.desc: A British diplomat is arrested on charges of working with Russian mafia. After death threats to his wife, they are taken into protective custody. Then the MI6 shows up with a new piece of the puzzle.

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: Stranger with My Face
programme.desc: Mystery with Catherine Hicks. A teenager uncovers a series of shocking revelations when she learns she has an identical twin who has been kept secret from her.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: In 1812, young British aristocrat Edmund Talbot travels by ship to Australia and learns more about himself and about life than he had ever bargained for.

programme.title: Mystery Woman
programme.desc: Amicably divorced from art gallery keeper Elliot McCallister, Samantha Kinsey (who always dreamed of being a detective like her prosecutor's office friend, Cassie,) inherits her uncle's mystery-specialized bookshop. It comes with a mysterious clerk, presumed retired spy Ian Philby. Her former literature professor and true crime author Jack Stenning's adopted daughter with psychic abilities, Tracy, bemoans her father's dismissal of her fear of his writing a book about her nightmarish vision of a ten-year-old murder, which reveals a witness survived. At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: Desolation Canyon
programme.desc: Western about a sheriff ('Dallas' star, Patrick Duffy) who persuades his old friend (Stacy Keach, 'Prison Break'), a retired gunslinger, to join himin pursuit of a notorious gang. The band of outlaws counts the gunslinger's son as one of its members.

programme.desc: Denise Richards plays Lauren, a divorced wedding-planner who falls for the groom-to-be (Dean Cain).

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: A Holocaust survivor heads for America where she dreams of starting a new life, but finds it difficult to put the past behind her, especially when she's forced to relive the nightmare of Auschwitz.

programme.desc: Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.

While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: Niagara Motel
programme.desc: A group of struggling individuals cross paths at a low-rent motel in Niagara Falls: a knockout waitress being recruited to star in low budget porn videos, a young couple with a criminal past struggling to recover their child from social services, a middle class husband and wife in a marriage that is disintegrating, a woeful drunken motel manager, a prostitute working to support two small children...

programme.title: Claire
programme.desc: Loosely based on a Japanese fairytale, an elderly male couple on a farm in the 1920's South find a little girl from the moon inside an ear of corn and raise her as their own.

programme.title: A Deadly Encounter
programme.desc: Thriller. After working late one night, restaurant hostess Joanne Sanders (Laura Leighton, ʻMelrose Placeʼ) accidentally cuts up a car on the highway, which leads the other driver (Alain Goulem, ʻ18 to Lifeʼ) to stalk and harass her, determined to exact his revenge.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Sharks Of the Badlands

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: This time we are off to Nevada on the hunt for the Camel Spider. This arachnid, sometimes called a wind scorpion, is neither a true spider nor a scorpion. Only 6 inches long, they a voracious feeders and prey on termites, darkling beetles and other ground dwelling insects. This little giant has been known to feed on snakes, small lizards, birds and rodents. They do not normally attack humans, but when they do, their bite can be extremely painful.

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: The first day of darkness has arrived at the refuge. Now, the days are growing shorter, causing Bob, Heimo and the Lewis family to set additional traps and continue hunting for food. Heimo uses what little daylight there is to catch his biggest adversary and competition for resources - the wolf. But overflow on the river blocks his path home and jeopardizes his golden rule of surviving the winter: "Always return home before the faint light of day is gone." Bob returns to the refuge from town and begins to follow fresh animal tracks as a result of the constant snowfall. Ray's daughters, Emma, Sarah and Molly, become emotional after what might be their last winter at the refuge as a family.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Big Fish Man
programme.desc: World record-holding angler Jakub Vagner would die for fishing and has come close more than once. In Big Fish Man he embarks on extreme fishing expeditions to the most remote regions of the world in search of fish that have never before been filmed in the wild many weighing more than 200kg and measuring over six metres in length. His exploits take us to a variety of remote locations Congo, Mongolia, Europe, Canada, Thailand, Ecuador and Peru. Carrying all his kit and supplies, Jakub spends days trekking through unforgiving jungle and paddling against wild river currents. He survives using the hunting and foraging skills hes honed over almost two decades of fishing missions. On his visually stunning adventure he tries to land the Amazons largest freshwater fish in Ecuador and the mighty Goliath Tiger Fish, with its 32 shark-like teeth, in Congo. He enlists the help of nomadic reindeer herders to land a giant Taimen in the ice cold rapids of the Shishgid River in Mongolia and tries to catch a massive Northern Pike in the Canadian sub-Arctic even though their natural habitat is completely frozen over. The series is packed with drama and danger. Jakub is stubborn and determined as time after time he faces nature at its most extreme.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: The San Jose Sharks want Wayde and Brett to design a tank for their new VIP lounge in the SAP Arena. COO John Tortora has come up with some tough challenges for the guys to make this tank something special. He wants replica hockey equipment, the infamous San Jose Shark Head, and of course real live sharks inside the tank. Wayde and Brett only have until the first puck drops to put this shark tank in the Shark Tank. Can the guys skate by to score a win, or will they get flattened by a hard hitting tank-tastrophe?

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty.

programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Deadly Islands
programme.desc: Renowned zoologist, animal trainer, and television presenter Dave Salmoni is no stranger to adventure. Having trekked the globe to study creatures and their unique ecosystems, Dave has walked the line between the wild and human world to explore the delicate balance between wildlife and civilization. From the people behind the stunning natural history series, PLANET EARTH and NORTH AMERICA, DEADLY ISLANDS sees Dave's skills tested to the limits as he lives alongside some of Mother Nature's fiercest predators. Dave visits some of the world's most remote islands to investigate how and why their native inhabitants have been so spectacularly successful at surviving - despite the harshest of conditions. In a unique approach that blends all the splendour of a natural history documentary series with an incredible investigative twist, audiences follow Dave as detective while he sets out to crack some of the last big secrets surrounding some of the world's most successful natural-born killers. Only by venturing closer than most would dare to some of the planet's most dangerous animals-from the great hammerhead shark to the grizzly bear. Can Dave uncover their secrets. How have they come to thrive so spectacularly in these remote places, often in confined island settings? Dave's skills will be tested to the limits as he lives alongside some of Mother Nature's fiercest predators, on some of the world's most remote islands,all to solve the DEADLY ISLANDS.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive
programme.desc: Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.title: Отважные
programme.desc: Сериал рассказывает о работе специального подразделения полиции, занимающегося проблемами домашнего насилия. Четыре главные героини помогают женщинам, детям и даже мужчинам, страдающим от тирании, побоев, унижений и других способов угнетения со стороны близких людей. Героини сериала будут попадать в сложные и опасные ситуации, спасая жизни и восстанавливая справедливость. Каждая женщина из этой четверки тоже прошла через насилие: у каждой – своя история, скелет в шкафу и сильная мотивация заниматься именно этим делом.

programme.desc: Сотрудники полиции участвуют во всех особо важных делах – спасении заложников и переговорах с террористами, эвакуации жителей и обезвреживании бомб, охоте на серийного убийцу и даже решении семейных конфликтов. programme.title: Lamput

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are surprised to discover that their past actions have consequences. / Whilst Gumball and Darwin make fun of Mum and Dad for being old their voices start to break. / Sarah the new kid in school is Gumball and Darwin's number one slightly obsessive fan. / The new coach at Elmore High stands up to Jamie. / Miss Simian has to save herself from a contagious Joy virus infecting the whole school. / The secret behind Anton's immortality. / The kids finally get the puppy they always wanted except it's a turtle. / When Mum reveals that Gumball's real name is Zach Gumball adopts a cheesy annoying persona to match the name. / Nothing much is happening for Gumball and Darwin and the background characters in Elmore seize their moment.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: As Skips continues to help everyone with problems relating to broken supplies, Mordecai and Rigby are attempting to print something, but encounter error # 219. They ask Skips if he can fix it, but when he says no and leaves the room depressed (because they called someone to fix the computer and Skips has no idea how computers work), he goes to a library to figure out how to fix computers. After this, he returns to the park only to find out that the problem had become an error # 220.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Where the Wild Chads Are: Chad takes Clarence out to the woods for some grizzly-man camping, but Clarence is disappointed at the cushy set up; heaters, a hammock, even a portable TV. To make it a more rugged adventure, Clarence ditches Chad's wallet, cell phone, and all their food, but it may be too much wilderness for them to handle. / Breehn Ho!: Avast mateys! Clarence and Sumo are psyched to play their pirate-themed board game, Thirty Days and Seven Seas, until they learn Jeff has invited boring old Breehn along. After Breehn gets frustrated and leaves, it's up to the three scallywags to rescue Breehn from an intense flood.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. Each episode finds the kids either venturing into unexplored areas of the Creek, encountering new Creek Kids, or just getting into trouble at their hang out - the Stump.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin start noticing small details around Elmore High that don't add up. They come to the conclusion that Molly has disappeared, even though nobody else remembers her ever having existed. Mr Small confirms their suspicions and tells them that things are not always what they seem in Elmore. They set off on a quest to rescue Molly in an alternate dimension, and soon need rescuing themselves!

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Clayton is a compulsive liar, but Gumball discovers he wasn't lying about his awesome martial arts move. Gumball confronts Clayton about his fabled Seven Pressure Point Heart Exploding Technique, assuming it's another one of his outlandish claims. Darwin and Gumball intervene to help Clayton start embracing the truth. However, when they discover the move is as effective as he claimed, they really wish he'd been lying.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. programme.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
programme.desc: A broken VHS tape needs to be fixed.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: As Skips continues to help everyone with problems relating to broken supplies, Mordecai and Rigby are attempting to print something, but encounter error # 219. They ask Skips if he can fix it, but when he says no and leaves the room depressed (because they called someone to fix the computer and Skips has no idea how computers work), he goes to a library to figure out how to fix computers. After this, he returns to the park only to find out that the problem had become an error # 220.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: Join our hosts, adventurer Josh Gates, scientist Phil Torres and paranormal researcher Jessica Chobot, as they travel around the planet uncovering the secrets behind supernatural phenomena, mythical beasts and alien activity. Each trip leads the team on a quest to reveal the bizarre truth of these fascinating stories. Epsiodes include a journey deep into the Cambodian jungle to search for a monster from a lost city; a spelunking expedition sees the team investigating the largest cave system in the world; an active volcano in Washington state might hold the clue to some extraterrestrial mysteries; and an exploration of a haunted dwelling in the Amazon causes panic in the middle of the night.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, the couple quickly get to know each other -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude will serve them well.
