programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Ограбление по-женски
programme.desc: Грабить банки – совсем не женское дело. Но если жизнь заставит, то наши женщины справятся и с этим. Нина, Тома и Света – закадычные подруги. Судьба их не слишком баловала. Нина одна растит сына и работает уборщицей в банке. Тома – учительница, вечно влюбляющаяся не в тех мужчин. Света – медицинский работник среднего звена, вынужденная делить с бывшим супругом скромную жилплощадь. Все, что накоплено на черный день, подруги хранят в том самом банке, где работает Нина. Однажды Нина случайно узнает, что все деньги вкладчиков украдены, и чтобы замести следы – планируется инсценировка ограбления. Возмущенные подруги решают проникнуть в хранилище банка и забрать свои вклады. И это им удалось! Но теперь у них "на хвосте" и полиция, и бандиты, чьи деньги они случайно прихватили с собой…

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: The Flock
programme.desc: This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

programme.title: Existenz
programme.desc: A game designer on the run from assassins must play her latest virtual reality creation with a marketing trainee to determine if the game has been damaged.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Copper Jack Stone purposefully orchestrates a bank robbery in order to be thrown into prison with the notorious Russian kingpin Balam. Balam is more than just a mob criminal; he's a very cunning and dangerous lord who controls the police force from behind bars. Balam lives in prison as a cover for his real power, which is King of the city. His cell is a lavish private room built specifically for him, inaccessible to most in the depths of the prison structure. Even the warden fears venturing into his area of the prison. However, even surrounded by his loyal henchmen and guards in his sectioned off fortress, Balam doesn't know Jack is coming for him to avenge his family, who Balam murdered in cold blood. Balam is tough... but Jack is tougher.

programme.title: Dragon Blade
programme.desc: In northwest China, 48 BC (50 BC on screen in the English version), a security company under Han China's current government called The Silk Road Protection Squad is committed to stopping battles and promoting the idea of peace. Huo An (Jackie Chan), the captain, successfully averts a battle between the Indian people and Han dynasty. The group returns to their unnamed home city, where Huo An's gentle Uyghurs wife Xiuqing (Mika Wang) serves as a schoolteacher for orphans. However, the government uncovers evidence that someone in the group is corrupt, causing the entire group to be sentenced to construction work at Wild Geese Gate, a ruined fortress. Once they arrive, the group pays respects at the shrine of a fallen Chinese general. They originally were child-slaves of Han descent, but the general had later rescued them.

programme.title: Corner Office
programme.desc: Orson, a compulsive bureaucrat who discovers a secret room.

programme.title: The Lucky Dragon
programme.desc: A young, Chinese dragon punished by the gods to be a mere mortal is cast down to earth. He is forced to make his way in a strange land until the evil forces discover his true identity. Take part in a world full of imagination while following the journey of a mischievous dragon who has been transformed by magic into a little boy and exiled from his home to live among humans. When both good and evil forces learn that a dragon has arrived, they look for him as he is the only one who can find the magical sword—whose owner can rule the universe! Will he find the sword in time before it gets into the wrong hands? Will he ever become a dragon again?

programme.title: Train Master
programme.desc: 62 year old Jeremiah Wilson is truly the Train Master of Willamette Western Railroad. He lives, breaths, and eats railroad. When Brett Banner, 32 year old heir to New York Eastern talks his dad into purchasing Willamette Western, there is immediately a clash between himself and Jeremiah. Jeremiah is fired by Brett two years from retirement and turns into a angry, depressed grandfather. When Brett's nine year old son Justin realizes Jeremiah's grandson Thomas can drive a locomotive, he kidnaps and holds Thomas' favorite dinosaur ransom. Justin, Thomas and 3 other children board an old engine in for repairs and accidentally turns it into runaway engine causing a chain reaction of events.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Uncle Nino
programme.desc: A distant, slightly dysfunctional family is brought closer together when the father's long-estranged Uncle Nino comes from Italy to Chicago for a surprise visit.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: See You in September
programme.desc: See You in September is an original romantic comedy set in current day Manhattan. The film centers around Lindsay, a beautiful woman who seemingly has it all, but is deeply afraid of commitment. When she finds out that her therapist takes a vacation for the entire month of August she feels shocked and abandoned. Instead of taking this news lying down, Lindsay enlists the help of her acerbic best friend Monica to come up with a solution. With the assistance of "Craig's List", Lindsay puts together a group therapy session for all Manhattanites who are in need of therapy, but more importantly angry at their therapists for abandoning them.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: Bernie Lootz (William H. Macy) is a long-time "cooler" at the Shangri-La casino in Las Vegas: he is paid to bring his black cloud to any table where a gambler is on a roll. But when Bernie's luck starts changing for the better--thanks in part to a pretty cocktail waitress--he suddenly loses his cooling talents, incurring the ire of the casino owner in the process.

programme.title: The Zodiac
programme.desc: THE ZODIAC takes a different look at the famous Zodiac Killer case from other screen treatments of the murders. More than a simple crime story, the film is an emotional thriller focusing on the murders' impact on victims, their families and the wider community. The film follows a police detective and his son who become obsessed with the murders and endanger their family in the process.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond, a money launderer struggling with memory loss sustained in a car crash, goes on the run, evading the police while carrying heaps of stolen cash he knows nothing about. Moe and his partner in crime Bobby "Skunk" Cohen had been given a job by Bobby's uncle Perico, wherein he gave them a sum of $20 million to launder. However, the two are ambushed while doing a side job by corrupt police officers. The two manage to escape the cops, but soon after end up in a car accident.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: The great Wesley Snipes (Blade himself!) stars as "The Hunter" in this Mauro Borrelli (The Ghostmaker) directed film. The Recall also stars RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) and Hannah Rose May (Ballers). The movie tells the tale of five friends vacationing at a remote lake house, expecting nothing less than a good time. Unbeknownst to them, Earth is under an alien invasion and in the thralls of a mass-abduction. Director Borelli is a former collaborator of director Tim Burton and the film illustrator for blockbuster films such as Pirates of the Caribbean and Captain America. The Recall will also be shot for the new Barco Escape three-screen, panoramic theatrical format, which fully surrounds audiences and offers the ultimate immersive cinema experience. Portions of the films will also be shot in Virtual Reality.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions
programme.desc: A hybrid of animated, experimental, feature and genre film in found footage technique, with a radio phonic sound and of unexpected, almost 40-minute duration. Journalist Isidor Dukas visits the Institute for Research on Psychic Phenomena and Mental Film when a confrontation with one of the test subjects transforms a routine check into a never-ending maze. Barić's work calls into question issues surrounding artistic practices in the digital age including ideas about authenticity, simulation/replication and appropriation.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Raspberry Magic
programme.desc: "Raspberry Magic" is a coming-of-age story about 11-year-old Monica Shah, who thinks she must win the science fair in order to bring her father back after he runs out on the family. She blames herself for her parents' problems, and takes charge when her mother falls into a deep depression. Set behind the backdrop of a beautiful forest, Monica's experiment uses touch therapy to help raspberries grow faster. She asks, is it nature or nurture that can truly help a being grow? Does it even matter? Through her ups and downs with her family, she learns that it's a complex question, and the answer isn't so simple.

programme.title: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
programme.desc: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

programme.title: The Adventure Scouts
programme.desc: A coming of age movie about a group of boys and girls called "adventure scouts" who return from a camping trip to discover their small town is being held captive by a gang of motorcycle-riding knuckleheads. Using only their scouting knowledge and camping equipment, the kids take down the gang members one by one, reunite with family members, and restore the community's sense of pride.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: See You in September
programme.desc: See You in September is an original romantic comedy set in current day Manhattan. The film centers around Lindsay, a beautiful woman who seemingly has it all, but is deeply afraid of commitment. When she finds out that her therapist takes a vacation for the entire month of August she feels shocked and abandoned. Instead of taking this news lying down, Lindsay enlists the help of her acerbic best friend Monica to come up with a solution. With the assistance of "Craig's List", Lindsay puts together a group therapy session for all Manhattanites who are in need of therapy, but more importantly angry at their therapists for abandoning them.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Foolproof
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.

programme.title: Wake
programme.desc: When things get tough for offbeat Carys Reitman, she does what any emotionally isolated, modern girl would do - she goes to strangers' funerals. At one fateful funeral, she unexpectedly meets Tyler, a man mourning his fiancée. Despite the warnings of her undertaker best friend Shane and her roommate Lila, she finds herself connecting to someone for the first time. Searching for answers, Carys goes to see her estranged mother to confront her past. And as she tries to open herself to the risks of love with Tyler, she realizes she may have more to fear than just a broken heart.

programme.title: One Upon a Time in Deadwood
programme.desc: A lone gunslinger with no name is poisoned by Ursula, a young woman who gives him the task of retrieving her kidnapped sister Abigale, in whose possession he'll find the antidote. The slow-acting poison gives him three days to rescue the heiress's sibling. He is forced to accompany Ursula to Deadwood, where Abigale is held by a gang of notorious criminals. She is kept in their lair, the Gem Saloon. A string of gun battles ensues.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: Adventure movie. Adventure movie, produced in 2005. Two five year old cousins, Anna and ailing Marios, live far away from the see and they never saw it. Anna persuates her father to leave his job and take them to the sea so that Marios will get better.

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: American drama, produced in 2004. An American, French, German, Italian, Rumanian, and British co-production. The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

programme.title: Džons Viks
programme.desc: Džons Viks uzzina par iespēju sakaut Augsto Galdu.

programme.title: Džokers
programme.desc: Niks Vailds ir apsargs Lasvegasā, kura vājība ir azartspēles. Cenšoties palīdzēt savai draudzenei, viņš pamatīgi sadusmo bagātu mafijas bosu un iekuļas lielās nepatikšanās. Tagad viņam priekšā liktenīgā spēle, uz kuras liktas lielas likmes. Visu vai neko - citas izvēles nav. Galvenajās lomās: Džeisons Stethems, Dominika Garsija-Lorido, Sofija Vergara.

programme.title: Slow TV
programme.desc: Rudens upe.

programme.title: Džons Viks
programme.desc: Džons Viks uzzina par iespēju sakaut Augsto Galdu.

Džona F. Kenedija lidostā gandrīz notiek divu lidmašīnu sadursme. Notikušajā tiek vainots satiksmes kontrolieris Dilans, kurš notikuma laikā, tieši plkst. 14:22 redzējis neizskaidrojamu gaismu un nav bijis spējīgs pildīt savus pienākumus. Viņš tiek atstādināts no darba un iepazīstas ar Sāru, kura bijusi pasažiere vienā no lidmašīnām. Abu starpā uzreiz uzplaukst jūtas, taču viņi sāk novērot savādas lietas - it kā diena ietu pa apli, un tieši plkst. 14:22 atkal sāk atkārtoties tie paši notikumi, viņi satiek tos pašus cilvēkus. Lai izkļūtu no šī apburtā loka, viņiem nāksies atšķetināt sarežģītas mistērijas. Galvenajās lomās: Maiks Huizmans, Teresa Palmere, Sems Rīds

programme.title: Džons Viks
programme.desc: Džons Viks uzzina par iespēju sakaut Augsto Galdu.

Džona F. Kenedija lidostā gandrīz notiek divu lidmašīnu sadursme. Notikušajā tiek vainots satiksmes kontrolieris Dilans, kurš notikuma laikā, tieši plkst. 14:22 redzējis neizskaidrojamu gaismu un nav bijis spējīgs pildīt savus pienākumus. Viņš tiek atstādināts no darba un iepazīstas ar Sāru, kura bijusi pasažiere vienā no lidmašīnām. Abu starpā uzreiz uzplaukst jūtas, taču viņi sāk novērot savādas lietas - it kā diena ietu pa apli, un tieši plkst. 14:22 atkal sāk atkārtoties tie paši notikumi, viņi satiek tos pašus cilvēkus. Lai izkļūtu no šī apburtā loka, viņiem nāksies atšķetināt sarežģītas mistērijas. Galvenajās lomās: Maiks Huizmans, Teresa Palmere, Sems Rīds

programme.title: Boss Level: Augstākais līmenis
programme.desc: Militārist Rojs ir iestrēdzis laikā - viņam nākas atkal un atkal no jauna izdzīvot dienu, kurā viņš tika nogalināts. Nu viņš katru dienu tiek nogalināts citā veidā - kādu dienu viņu saskalda ar mačeti, pēc tam nogalē ar helikoptera lielgabalu, bet tad divas skaistules superātrā auto ieplānojušas ko pavisam negantu. Iestrēdzis laika cilpā, kurā katru baltu dienu tiek nogalināts, Rojs sāk meklēt iespējas no tās izkļūt.

programme.title: Sekss un lielpilsēta
programme.desc: Kerijas Bredšovas sapnis beidzot ir piepildījies – viņa precēsies ar Lielisko vīrieti. Viņš jau reiz ir bijis laulībā, tāpēc vēlas nelielas svinības, taču Kerija, pielaikojot labāko dizaineru kāzu kleitas, ātri vien aizraujas ar domu par modes dāmas sapņu kāzām. Pēc sarunas ar Mirandu, kura būtībā runā par savas laulības problēmām, Lielisko vīrieti pārņem šaubas. Stīva un Mirandas attiecībās iestājies panīkums, tāpēc abi pārguļ ar citiem cilvēkiem un galu galā izšķiras. Kad Lieliskais vīrietis pamet Keriju pie altāra, draudzenes dodas ceļojumā, kam bija jākļūst par jaunā pāra medusmēnesi. Draudzenes ir lieliska kompānija, taču Kerija nespēj uzreiz atgūt dzīvesprieku. Samantu kaitina prombūtne no arvien nevaļīgākā Smita, kura aktiera karjera uzņem apgriezienus, tāpēc viņa izseko glīto jaunekli. Valentīna dienā Miranda atzīstas Kerijai, ka ir vainojama Lieliskā vīrieša bēgšanā. Rezultātā Kerija izlīgst ar savu mīļoto, un abi salaulājas miertiesneša kabinetā.

programme.title: Ģimene
programme.desc: Bruklinas noziedzniekam Džovanni Manzoni bija viss līdz mirklim, kad viņš kļuva par bandītu nodevēju. Lai cik reižu aģents Stensfīlds pārvietotu Džovanni un viņa ģimeni, briesmas arvien pastāv. Kad ģimene kārtējo reizi tiek atrasta, Džovanni liek savai sievai Megijai un abiem bērniem Vorenam un Bellai pārcelties uz klusu ciematu Francijā. Tā šķiet ideāla vieta, kur izbēgt no noziedznieku vērīgajām acīm, taču ģimene ar pieredzi kriminālajā pasaulē atgriežas pie netīrā darba, kārtējo reizi nonākot sindikāta redzeslokā.

programme.title: Vecāks par 21 gadu
programme.desc: Džefs ir paraugstudents, kurš līdz šim visu darījis pareizi un mācījies cītīgi. Taču viņa divdesmit pirmā dzimšanas diena iekritusi tieši pirms iestājeksāmieniem medicīnas skolā, un viņa divi labākie draugi uzaicina Džefu iedzert alu. Kad Džefs pārmaiņas pēc nolemj šajā dienā beidzot darīt visu, ko vien viņam iegribas, ieplānotais mierīgais vakars izvēršas par īstu elli, kur neviens no iesaistītajiem nespēs aizmirst vēl ilgi.

programme.title: Smita kungs un kundze
programme.desc: Andželina Džolija un Breds Pits romantiski spraigajā kriminālkomēdijā par algotu slepkavu slepeno dzīvi. Džons un Džeina Smiti ir parasts laulātais pāris, kas dzīvo ikdienišķu laulāto dzīvi tipiskā piepilsētas mājā. Bet viņiem katram ir savs noslēpums - viņi ir slīpēti pasūtījuma slepkavas, kurus algo konkurējošas organizācijas. Viss sagriežas kājām gaisā un izvēršas neaizmirstamā, spraigā un romantiskā piedzīvojumā, kad viņi atklāj šo gadiem glabāto noslēpumu, jo abi saņem nākamo uzdevumu - nogalināt vienam otru!

programme.title: Dziļi kosmosā
programme.desc: Kosmosa kuģis ar trīs cilvēku apkalpi dodas divu gadu ilgā misijā uz Marsu, lai izzinātu, vai uz šīs planētas iespējams dzīvot. Jau esot ceļā, viņi atklāj, ka uz kuģa ir ceturtais pasažieris, kurš tur nonācis nejauši. Ir par vēlu, lai atgrieztos, taču kuģa dzīvības uzturēšanas sistēmas ir bojātas, resursi strauji izsīkst, un visiem izdzīvot nebūs iespējams. Komanda nonāk smagas izšķiršanās priekšā. Galvenajās lomās: Anna Kendrika, Daniels Dae Kims, Tonija Kolete

programme.title: Valdības noslēpumi
programme.desc: Keira Naitlija un Ralfs Fainss trillerī uz patiesiem notikumiem. Ir 2003. gads. ASV un britu politiķi debatē par Irākas masu iznīcināšanas ieročiem, to specdienesti tikmēr aktīvi strādā, lai izplatītu nepatiesu informāciju, kas pamatotu iebrukumu šajā valstī. Britu aģente nostājas pret savu valsti, lai atklātu patiesību sabiedrībai par ASV slepenās organizācijas NSA nelegālām darbībām, lai sankcionētu iebrukumu Irākā.

programme.title: Maijs decembrī
programme.desc: Pagājis 20 gadu, kopš 36 gadus vecā Greisija uzsāka romānu ar 13 gadus veco dēla klasesbiedru Džo. Laimīgā ģimenes fasāde sāk irt, kad pie viņiem ierodas televīzijas aktrise Elizabete, lai veiktu izpēti savai nākamajai lomai, kurā atveidos Greisiju.

programme.title: Chef Grudge Match
programme.desc: Host Laila Ali challenges chefs to settle their disputes in a single round, head-to-head culinary battle. They all come here to call each other out, put their favorite knives on the line, and bury the hatchet. The winners walk out with $10,000 cash, a prized knife from the losing chef's knife roll and bragging rights for life!

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is making a well-earned lunch for Ladd and his new cowgirl, Paige, who are out shipping cattle. There's amazing Pasta with Pancetta and Corn, perfect for her pasta-loving daughter who has just joined the family business. On the side, there's delicious Lemon Pepper Chopped Salad and fantastic Individual Skillet Focaccia. For dessert, Ree has rancher-approved Easy Chocolate Orange Ice Cream.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: Sun's out, grills out! Michael Symon soaks up the summertime weather and fires up his grill to encourage everyone to get cooking out with his easy and crowd-pleasing outdoor dinners. From sticky ribs to desserts, Michael shares his grilling tips and tricks to make every meal flamingly delicious. Self-shot from his New York backyard, cook along with Michael as he works live fire to show how simple and fun it is to make amazing dishes on the outdoor grill.

programme.title: Ciao House
programme.desc: Hosts and judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Gabe Bertaccini welcome 10 talented chefs to Ciao House, where they will live together in a beautiful Tuscan villa and be tested like never before on their proficiency with Italian cuisine. programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: This week, we're setting sail with Disney Cruise Line to visit Disney Lookout Cay, where the native sea creatures are so beautiful and inspiring that Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown ask the bakers to create sea animal desserts in an ocean or beach setting. Then, very special guests Captain Mickey Mouse and Captain Minnie Mouse drop by for a visit because there is an amazing prize at stake in this challenge -- the winning baker will enjoy a Disney Cruise Vacation.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine heads to Shreveport, Louisiana, to meet Mavice, the owner of her father's legacy restaurant, Eddie's. The seafood spot is best known for its famous stuffed shrimp, but neither the signature dish nor the restaurant are what they used to be. Mavice's stubborn refusal to adapt is running the food, finances and family into the ground. Robert must convince Mavice to make the changes necessary to save her family's legacy and their livelihood.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon
programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out
programme.desc: Just how far is a chef willing to go to win a cooking competition? Hosted by Brian Malarkey, Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out hands four chefs each $25,000 and the opportunity to spend that money on helping themselves or sabotaging their competitors. Ingredients will be thieved, utensils destroyed and valuable time on the clock lost when the chefs compete to cook delicious dishes while also having to outplot the competition. Nothing is out of bounds when money changes hands and we see just how far chefs will go to ensure they have the winning dish.

programme.title: Chef Grudge Match
programme.desc: Host Laila Ali challenges chefs to settle their disputes in a single round, head-to-head culinary battle. They all come here to call each other out, put their favorite knives on the line, and bury the hatchet. The winners walk out with $10,000 cash, a prized knife from the losing chef's knife roll and bragging rights for life!

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is throwing a cocktail bash for the crew helping to open her store in town. There's a delicious line up of make-ahead portable canapes on the menu: juicy Asian Beef Skewers, retro Ham Salad in Endive Cups, simple Salami Roll Ups, a no-cook Crudite platter and divine Tiny Tomato Tarts. There are sweet treats too -- decadent Black and White Brownies and chewy Caramel Nut Truffles -- plus a Pawhuska Prohibition Punch to toast the team.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is sharing delicious new ideas for Christmas cooking. She has a trio of fast, fabulous bites; Grilled Chicken Skewers, Fig and Goat Cheese Bruschetta and no-cook Cheesy Mini Peppers. Chocolate Candy Cane Cookies are left out for Santa, and she's shaking up her sides for the big feast with Yorkshire Pudding. Plus, a warm, fragrant Mulled Apple Cider that's perfect for friends and family.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay

The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: This week, we're setting sail with Disney Cruise Line to visit Disney Lookout Cay, where the native sea creatures are so beautiful and inspiring that Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown ask the bakers to create sea animal desserts in an ocean or beach setting. For the twist, bakers are required to make a custom ice cream with a mix-in that goes with their dessert. Then, very special guests Captain Mickey Mouse and Captain Minnie Mouse drop by for a visit because there is an amazing prize at stake in this challenge -- the winning baker will enjoy a Disney Cruise Vacation.

programme.title: Minari
programme.desc: Korejiešu amerikāņu ģimene pārceļas uz fermu Arkanzasā, meklējot paši savu amerikāņu sapni. Grūtības, ar ko viņi sastopas jaunās dzīves sākumā, atklāj arī ģimenes saišu spēku un to, kas patiesībā ir mājas.

programme.title: Nezvēri
programme.desc: No dzimtenes izceļojis franču pāris Spānijas laukos vada organisko saimniecību, taču rodas nesaskaņas ar vietējiem ciemata iedzīvotājiem.

programme.title: Atzīstiet manu vainu
programme.desc: Kad policijai beidzot izdodas arestēt divdesmit Lukēzi mafijas klana locekļus, Džekijs Dinoršio, ar iesauku Resnais, kurš jau izcieš 30 gadu cietumsodu, saņem vilinošu piedāvājumu – Džekiju atbrīvos priekšlaicīgi, ja viņš liecinās pret saviem draugiem. Bet Resnais Di nav nodevējs! Tiesas procesā, kas izrādīsies garākais un skandalozākais ASV tiesu praksē, Džekijs sevi aizstāvēs pats.

programme.title: Didi
programme.desc: 2008. gadā, pēdējā vasaras mēnesī pirms vidusskolas sākuma, 13 gadus vecs zēns iemācās to, ko viņa ģimene nevar viņam iemācīt: kā slidot, kā flirtēt un kā mīlēt savu mammu.

programme.title: Smurfi: Zudušais ciemats
programme.desc: Jaunajā, pilnībā animētajā "Smurfu" sērijā mūsu varoņi atrod noslēpumainu karti un dodas briesmu pilnajā piedzīvojumā, lai meklētu zudušo ciematu. Ceļš smurfus vedīs cauri noslēpumainam mežam, kur dzīvo maģiskas būtnes, bet viņiem pa pēdām sekos ļaunais burvis Gargamelis. Smurfi pat nenojauš, ka, izejot cauri visiem pārbaudījumiem, viņi atklās smurfu lielāko noslēpumu.

programme.title: Zirnekļcilvēks: Tālu no mājām
programme.desc: Pīters Pārkers joprojām sēro par sava mentora Tonija Starka zaudējumu un cenšas atgriezties parasta pusaudža dzīvē. Viņš kopā ar klasesbiedriem dodas skolas ekskursijā uz Eiropu, cerot uz laiku nolikt malā supervaroņa kostīmu, izbaudīt Venēciju, Parīzi un Londonu, un beidzot atzīties mīlestībā Emdžejai. Tomēr Pītera plāni sabrūk, kad viņu uzmeklē Niks Furijs. Eiropas pilsētām uzbrūk noslēpumaini radījumi Elementāļi, kas spēj izsaukt dabas katastrofas. Pīteram nākas apvienot spēkus ar jaunu sabiedroto no paralēlās dimensijas Kventinu Beku, kuru pasaule iepazīst kā Misterio. Pīteram ir jāizlemj, vai viņš ir gatavs kļūt par nākamo "Dzelzs vīru" pasaulē, kas ir neatgriezeniski mainījusies, un jāmācās atšķirt patiesību no ilūzijas.

programme.title: Mīlestība dejas ritmā
programme.desc: Talantīgā balerīna Bārlova nolēmusi īstenot savu sapni Amerikas mākslas svētnīcā Ņujorkā. Diemžēl iepazīšanās ar svētnīcas realitāti nav īpaši patīkama – pieredzējusī baleta pasniedzēja Oksana skaidri un gaiši pasaka: Bārlova vēl nav ne tuvu pilnībai. Norijusi krupi, meitene nepadodas un piedalās jaunas Brodvejas deju izrādes atlasē. Režisors Zanders pievērš uzmanību Bārlovai un izvēlas viņu mēģinājumiem. Pēc dažām dienām topošās izrādes kodolam pievienojas talantīgais pianists Čārlijs. Tāpat kā Bārlova, viņš ieradies Ņujorkā, lai īstenotu sapni. Puisim un meitenei rodas simpātijas vienam pret otru, bet Zanders nav vienaldzīgs pret meiteni. Bārlova drīz vien sapinas mīlas trīsstūrī. Izrādes mēģinājumi kļūst arvien intensīvāki, slodze aug, un ne Bārlovai, ne Čārlijam neatliek laika nekam citam. Darbs vaiga sviedros, nemitīgā spriedze, sāncenšu nodevība un cīņa bez kompromisiem prasa visus spēkus.

programme.title: Rio
programme.desc: Animācijas filmas "Ledus laikmets" veidotāji sagatavojuši jaunu piedzīvojumu komēdiju visai ģimenei. Blū ir pieradināts papagailis, kas tā arī nav iemācījies lidot. Viņš visu mūžu baudījis ērtības Minesotas štata mazpilsētā, kur dzīvo kopā ar savu saimnieci Lindu. Blū un Linda ir pārliecināti, ka viņš ir pēdējais savas sugas pārstāvis, taču, kad izrādās, ka Riodežaneiro dzīvo arī krāšņā Džuela, abi dodas uz turieni, lai viņu uzmeklētu. Jau drīz vien pēc ierašanās Blū un Džuelu nolaupa eksotisko dzīvnieku tirgotāji. Taču Džuela ir radusi pie dzīves pilsētas ielās, un ar vairāku runājošu putnu palīdzību viņiem izdodas tikt brīvībā. Draugu un Džuelas iedrošināts, Blū beidzot iemācīsies lidot, lai varētu atgriezties pie savas labākās draudzenes Lindas.

programme.title: Rozalīna
programme.desc: Ikviens zina stāstu par Romeo un Džuljetu. Taču šajā stāstā iztrūkst kāda svarīga nianse – pirms Džuljetas bija viņas māsīca Rozalīna. Rozalīna ir līdz ausīm iemīlējusies Romeo un ir pārliecināta, ka abi ir kā radīti viens otram. Gadiem ilgi Rozalīna sapņo, kaut Romeo viņu noskūpstītu, un tad tas patiešām notiek! Viss šķiet ideāli, taču tad viņas māsīca Džuljeta pārceļas atpakaļ uz pilsētu un iekaro Romeo sirdi. Un tas vēl nav viss – Rozalīna uzzina par Džuljetas un Romeo pašnāvības plāniem. Vai viņa pagūs abus apturēt?

programme.title: Eliots: pats mazākais ziemeļbriedis
programme.desc: Eliots ir mazs zirdziņš, kuram ir ļoti liels sapnis, - ieņemt godpilno vietu Ziemassvētku vecīša ziemeļbriežu pajūgā, lai dāvātu bērniem prieku svētkos. Pēc tam kad Ziemassvētku vecītis nāk klajā ar paziņojumu, ka tūlīt dosies pensijā, mazajam Eliotam atliek vien tikai trīs dienas, lai pieradītu pārējiem, ka viņš ir šī goda cienīgs, neskatoties uz to, ka viņam nav atbilstošu ragu. Ja kaut ko ļoti vēlies no visas sirds, tad brīnumi notiek, vai ne?

programme.title: Moslija slepenais spēks
programme.desc: Kādā dīvainā valstī mīt ziloņiem līdzīgi zvēri ar gariem snuķiem. Dienu no dienas lempīgais Moslijs strādā smagu darbu, vilkdams arklu un ardams zemi. Moslija grūto ikdienu gaišāku padara tikai viņa mazais dēliņš Rū. Kādu dienu, klejodams pa laukiem, Rū atklāj senu, noslēpumainu alu ar dīvainiem zīmējumiem uz sienām. Šķiet, ka tajos ir attēloti tādi paši ziloņi kā viņš pats, taču ir viena atšķirība. Uz akmeņiem uzzīmētie ziloņi stāv uz pakaļkājām, un tie sniedzas pret debesīm nevis ar ziloņa nagiem, bet gan ar rokām! Satrauktais Rū redzēto izstāsta savam tētim, un Moslijs atceras senu leģendu, kas vēsta, ka kādreiz ziloņi tiešām staigājuši stāvus! Atklājums neļauj Moslijam mierīgi dzīvot, un viņš nolemj kopā ar Rū aizbēgt no fermas. Bēgdami no sava ļaunā saimnieka, Moslijs un Rū cer atrast noslēpumainu pilsētu, kurā joprojām dzīvo divkājaino ziloņu cilts.

programme.title: Dziedi!
programme.desc: Kad viņa teātrim draud slēgšana, uzņēmējdarbībā pieredzējušais koala Basters Mūns (Metjū Makkonahijs) sarīko dziesmu konkursu. Daudziem vietējiem zvēriem tas rada iespēju izpausties. Cūka Rosita (Rīza Viterspūna) ir māte un mājsaimniece, kura atteicās no pusaudža sapņa kļūt par dziedātāju. Pusaudze dzeloņcūka Eša (Skārleta Johansone) ir pancīga roķere alternatīvās mūzikas grupā. Gorillu Džoniju (Tārons Edžertons) viņa tēvs (Pīters Serafinovičs) grib pārliecināt pievērsties savam banku aplaupītāja arodam. Ikkatrs no šiem radījumiem vēlas piepildīt savu sapni un dziedāt no visas sirds!

programme.title: Šreks: ilgi un laimīgi
programme.desc: Cilvēkēdājs Šreks jau uzveicis ļaunu pūķi, atbrīvojis skaistu princesi un izglābis sievas ģimenes pārvaldīto karaļvalsti, bet tagad, pēc visa piedzīvotā, Šreks sāk ilgoties pēc vecās, labās cilvēkēdāja dzīves, kad ciema iedzīvotāji no viņa baidījās, nevis prasīja autogrāfus. Tāpēc, nedomājot par sekām, zaļais milzis noslēdz vienošanos ar viltīgo Rumpelrūķi. Parakstot līgumu, Šreks attopas ačgārnā un greizā Tāltālajā. Lai glābtu draugus, atjaunotu kārtību savā pasaulē un atgūtu Fionu, Šrekam būs krietni jāpacīnās.

programme.title: Pirmais kurss
programme.desc: Vientuļam pirmkursniekam koledžas ballītes laikā izveidojas stipra saikne ar studentu mentori.

programme.title: Sliktie puiši uz mūžu
programme.desc: Kriminālkomēdija ar Vilu Smitu un Mārtinu Lorensu. Sliktie puiši dzīvo katrs savu dzīvi — Maikam ir pusmūža krīze, viņš braukā ar sporta automobiļiem un regulāri iekuļas nepatīkamās situācijās, bet Markuss ir nodibinājis ģimeni, kļuvis par policijas inspektoru un arvien biežāk sāk domāt par pensionēšanos. Taču, kad pēc Maika dzīvības sāk tīkot nezināmi noziedznieki, leģendārais duets, atceroties savu nesalaužamo zvērestu - "sliktie puiši uz mūžu" - atkal apvienojas, lai veiktu vēl vienu bīstamu misiju.

programme.title: Pēdējais elpas vilciens
programme.desc: Patiess stāsts par dziļjūras nirējiem, kas cīnās, lai izglābtu savu komandas biedru, iesprostotu desmitiem metru zem okeāna virsmas.

programme.title: Cietais rieksts
programme.desc: 4. jūlijā, Neatkarības dienas svētku brīvdienās, valsti apdraud uzbrukums neaizsargātajai ASV infrastruktūrai. Noslēpumainais nozieguma izplānotājs ir pārdomājis visus mūsdienu aizsardzības aspektus, bet nav rēķinājies ar vecā kaluma pretinieku Džonu Makleinu. Bez maskas. Bez apmetņa. Bez problēmām.

programme.title: Trusītis Pēterītis
programme.desc: Ir mierpilna diena vienā no skaistākajām Anglijas vietām. Putniņi mīlīgi čivina, strautiņš urdz, un saule apmirdz zaļos pakalnus. Te pēkšņi cauri zālājam aizšaujas pūkains kamoliņš. Tas ir trusītis Pēterītis, un viņš dodas ļoti svarīgā misijā. Kopā ar trim māsiņām trusītis Pēterītis spriņģo taisnā ceļā uz Makgregora kunga mazdārziņa pusi. Tur izaudzēti labu labie dārzeņi, kas tā vien prasās tik apēsti. Taču reiz namā uz dzīvi apmetas Makgregora kunga radinieks, kurš par nelūgtajiem dārza labumu čiepējiem nemaz nav sajūsmā. Tā sākas nikni ķīviņi, jautri piedzīvojumi un daudz nepatikšanu, kurās trusītis Pēterītis kopā ar draugiem pamanīsies iekulties.

programme.title: Ledus laikmets 3: Dinozauru ēra
programme.desc: Filmu "Ledus laikmets" un "Ledus Laikmets 2" varoņi ir atgriezušies - gatavi jauniem piedzīvojumiem. Skrets joprojām nododas nenotveramās zīles medībām. Menijs un Elija gaida mazuļa piedzimšanu, sliņķis Sids mēģina iztēloties ģimenes dzīvi, rūpējoties par nočieptām dinozaura olām, bet zobenzobu tīģeris Djego apsver, vai viņš nav kļuvis pārāk mīkstčaulīgs, tik daudz laika pavadot draugu kompānijā. Dodoties glābt nelaimē nokļuvušo Sidu, draugi nokļūst neparastā pazemes pasaulē, kur aci pret aci sastopas ar dinozauriem un ir spiesti cīnīties gan ar zvēriem, gan augiem.

programme.title: Smurfi
programme.desc: Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.

programme.title: Tintina piedzīvojumi: Vienradža noslēpums
programme.desc: Stīvena Spīlberga triloģijas pirmā filma par slaveno Tintinu, zēnu - reportieri.

programme.title: Džumandži: Nākamais līmenis
programme.desc: Pagājis gads, kopš Spensers un viņa draugi Marta, Fridžs un Betānija atrada veco videospēli Džumandži, un nu viņi katrs devušies savu ceļu. Tomēr noslēpumainās galda spēles spēkam nav robežu, un nemanot četrinieks no jauna nonāk bīstamajā, mistikas apvītajā valstībā. Tiesa, šoreiz spēle ir mainījusies. Džumandži apdraud varens pretinieks, un tas šo pasauli alkst iznīcināt. Spēlē iesprostotos sagaida lieli izaicinājumi, un, lai uzveiktu ļaundari, viņiem būs jāspēj sadarboties. Varoņu ceļš vedīs pāri tuksnešiem, džungļiem, oāzēm un sniegotiem kalniem – vai viņiem maz būs pa spēkam no turienes izkļūt dzīviem?

programme.title: Kentervilas spoks
programme.desc: Sera Saimona de Kentervila rēgs jau 300 gadus klīst pa savrupmāju, meklēdams drosmīgu pēcnācēju, kurš viņu varētu atbrīvot no lāsta. Kad šajā savrupmājā ievācas kāda amerikāņu ģimene, spokam parādās cerību stariņš beidzot tapt atbrīvotam.

programme.title: Minioni
programme.desc: Minjoni, kas attīstījās no dzelteniem vienšūnas organismiem, dzīvo uz Zemes kopš aizvēsturiskiem laikiem. Viņu dzīves jēga ir kalpošana, taču mazie radījumi nemitīgi atrod sev nekam nederīgus saimniekus, sākot no dinozaura un beidzot ar Napoleonu. Ja minjoniem nav saimnieka, kuram zemoties, viņi ieslīgst dziļā depresijā. Taču minjonam Kevinam ir plāns – kopā ar draugiem Stjuartu un Bobu viņš dodas meklēt jaunu ļauno saimnieku, kuram sekot. Tā viņi atrod Skārletu Nomušītu, kas ir pasaulē pirmā superļaundare.

programme.title: Mis Moksi
programme.desc: Mis Moksi, pieradināta kaķenīte, brīvdienu laikā apmaldās, un viņai nākas atrast ceļu atpakaļ uz mājām, ceļojot cauri Dienvideiropai kopā ar, kaķa skatījumā, visnepatīkamākajām radībām, kādas vien iespējamas, – komisku suni un vecu, gudru putnu. Šī ceļojuma laikā viņa paplašina savu skatījumu uz dzīvi un atklāj patieso draudzības nozīmi.

programme.title: Tagad mani redzi
programme.desc: Četri jātnieki atkal apvienojas un kopā ar jauno iluzionistu paaudzi cenšas atmaskot dimantu mantinieces globālo naudas atmazgāšanas shēmu, kas kalpo noziedzniekiem.

programme.title: Blefotājs
programme.desc: Ekscentrisks miljardieris Džeiks uzaicina vecos draugus uz riskantu pokera spēli, kurā likmes ir tik augstas kā vēl nekad. Taču svešinieku iebrukums izmaina vakara gaitu – tagad uz spēles ir liktas arī klātesošo dzīvības.

programme.title: After. Pēc kritiena
programme.desc: Tesa ir gatava jaunam dzīves posmam. Spožais prestižas koledžas diploms paver jaunas iespējas – meitene atrod sapņu darbu starptautiskā kompānijā. Viņas nodoms pārcelties uz Sietlu nemaz neiepriecina Hārdinu. Viņa neapmierinātība, pārmetumi un mūžīgā greizsirdība sāpīgi ievaino Tesu un rada bažas. Vai ir vērts visu likt uz kārts un upurēt daudzsološu karjeru? Taču kā lai aizmirst kopā pavadītās naktis un kaislīgos skūpstus, viņa ciešos vīrieša apskāvienus un tuvību, kas padara traku?

programme.title: Nebēdnis
programme.desc: Bērts Kreišers ieguva slavu kā komiķis, kas pazīstams ar iesauku Mašīna, un etīdēs viņš stāsta par savu pieredzi ar krievu mafiju, dodoties koledžas ekskursijā. 23 gadus vēlāk, ceļojums sākas no jauna - mafija viņu un viņa atsvešināto tēvu nolaupa un aizved uz Krieviju, lai liktu viņam samaksāt par kaut ko, ko viņš it kā izdarījis. Bērtam un viņa tēvam nākas atsaukt atmiņā savas jaunības soļus un šajā nežēlīgajā karā ar sociopātisku noziedznieku ģimeni jāmēģina atrast kopīga valoda. Galvenajās lomās: Marks Hamils, Džimijs Taro, Iva Babičš

programme.title: Izlaušanās spēle
programme.desc: Seši savstarpēji nepazīstami cilvēki saņem ielūgumu piedalīties izlaušanās spēlē, kurā viņiem jāatrod izeja no dažādām telpām. Atrisinot virkni mīklu, veiksmīgais uzvarētājs balvā saņems 10 000 dolāru. Tomēr šķietami nevainīgā jautrība drīz izvēršas cīņā uz dzīvību un nāvi. Sapratuši, ka tam, kurš istabu pamet pēdējais, ir lemts mirt, viņi ir spiesti likt lietā visu savu atjautību, lai izdzīvotu.

Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find "My Lottery Dream Home".

programme.title: Neighborhood Watch
programme.desc: Parents say life with kids is chaotic, and now the constantly-recording cameras in homes prove it. These kids say and do the darndest things.

programme.title: Neighborhood Watch
programme.desc: Life is full of awkward, embarrassing fails, flubs, and faux pas that people would prefer to forget, but sometimes the camera catches it all.

programme.title: House Hunters Renovation
programme.desc: Finding the perfect home is never easy, but these aspirational house hunters don't plan on making it any easier for themselves. Meet the budding designers, builders and decorators determined to start from scratch and take on the mega projects all for themselves. Each episode features a new group of hopefuls looking to find cheap run-down houses with the aim of rapidly transforming them into their dream family homes. As families and friends embark on their mission to construct their future homes, follow their progress as they encounter all of excitement, stress and chaos that comes with home renovation.

programme.title: The Renovator
programme.desc: Marcus Lemonis will rescue frustrated families who have no idea where to begin to renovate a house that no longer meets their needs. During the process, Marcus will dig deep to determine the root of the clients' issues, provide solutions that transform their homes into ideal spaces and help mend their strained relationships. Ultimately, each family will get a stunning renovation and the tools they need to thrive in the home they used to love.

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: Most people only fantasize about living on an island, but we'll prove that an Island Life is possible for anyone. Tropical dreamers will be shown island properties that fit into any budget, from ultra-affordable to totally outrageous. We'll follow everyday families is search of their own slice of paradise, and prove that fantasy can be reality.

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: A couple with a connection to Martha's Vineyard is eager to move there and start building memories with their children. She has her heart set on a home with New England charm, while he hopes to be within walking distance to town.

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Attempting to bring families' dreams come to life, but on a budget, Beachfront Bargain Hunt shows that you don't have to be a millionaire if you want to live a life by the sea! Narrated by John Beach, this show follows a number of couples, families and people looking just for themselves exploring various beachfront's in USA, looking for homes that won't break the bank. Ensuring each person gets what they want, they are introduced to a number of properties that meet their ultimate dream home in the hopes that they will indeed find the one. With 101 episodes, Beachfront Bargain Hunt introduces you to the life that can be led, without breaking to bank, to live a life by the sea!

programme.title: House Hunters: Amazing Water Homes
programme.desc: After a stint in Arizona, a family looks to return home and find an oceanfront property in Seattle. They have a big budget and want beach access.

programme.title: House Hunters: Amazing Water Homes
programme.desc: A family is ready to give up surfside California for the Colorado River in Arizona. They love boats, jet skis and want plenty of space for their toys.

programme.title: Flip or Flop Vegas
programme.desc: Real estate agents Bristol and Aubrey Marunde welcome you to the City of Second Chances as they host this Las Vegas spin-off of the popular Flip or Flop reality home improvement show. Out in the Nevada sunshine, this husband-and-wife team buy up neglected homes in need of a bit of love and attention to renovate them so they can be sold at a profit. But like many things in Las Vegas – it's a gamble. They're never entirely sure of the challenges they face with the home until they start to restore it. MMA fighter Bristol is involved in overhauling the properties whilst Aubrey is in charge of style and design. But will their efforts pay off and will they hit the jackpot?

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries with Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Investigate a wide range of historically compelling topics and the mysteries surrounding each including the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell, John Wilkes Booth, and more. Each program within the franchise will showcase fresh, new evidence and perspectives including never-before-released documents to the general public, personal diaries and DNA evidence to unearth brand-new information about these infamous and enigmatic chapters in history.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: In December of 2017, The New York Times published a stunning front-page exposé about the Pentagon's mysterious UFO program, the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP). Featuring an interview with a former military intelligence official and Special Agent In-Charge, Luis Elizondo, who confirmed the existence of the hidden government program, the controversial story was the focus of worldwide attention. Previously run by Elizondo, AATIP was created to research and investigate Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) including numerous videos of reported encounters, three of which were released to a shocked public in 2017. Elizondo resigned after expressing to the government that these UAPs could pose a major threat to our national security and not enough was being done to deal with them or address our potential vulnerabilities. Now, as a part of HISTORY's groundbreaking new six-part, one-hour limited series UNIDENTIFIED: INSIDE AMERICA'S UFO INVESTIGATION, Elizondo is speaking out for the first time with Tom DeLonge, co-founder and President of To The Stars Academy of Arts & Science and Chris Mellon, former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense and Intelligence, to expose a series of startling encounters and embark on fascinating new investigations that will urge the public to ask questions and look for answers. The series will reveal newly authenticated evidence and footage, interviews from eyewitnesses and former military personnel who have never spoken out before, and extensive breakthroughs in understanding the technology behind these unknown phenomena in our skies.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: The Tesla Files
programme.desc: Why were trunks belonging to genius inventor Nikola Tesla confiscated in 1943? Did they contain the plans for nearly free worldwide electricity, massive death rays, and other inventions out of the future? A new investigation driven by declassified CIA documents suggests a secret history of bitter rivalries, government conspiracies, Cold War and WW2 spycraft, extra-terrestrial communication, and amazing achievements of a truly gifted man – Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.title: Grant
programme.desc: A three-part documentary series examining the life of the 18th President of the United States of America, Ulysses S. Grant, revealing his journey from humble beginnings to the highest office in the country. With epic, dramatised reconstructions alongside interviews with expert historians, the series comprehensibly depicts Grant's life as a man who helped to lead his country through one its most turbulent eras. A fascinating encapsulation of Grant, covering his years as a soldier fighting in a divided country, before emerging as a stoic champion for equality amongst all Americans.

programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

Featuring an interview with a former military intelligence official and Special Agent In-Charge, Luis Elizondo, who confirmed the existence of the hidden government program, the controversial story was the focus of worldwide attention. Previously run by Elizondo, AATIP was created to research and investigate Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) including numerous videos of reported encounters, three of which were released to a shocked public in 2017. Elizondo resigned after expressing to the government that these UAPs could pose a major threat to our national security and not enough was being done to deal with them or address our potential vulnerabilities. Now, as a part of HISTORY's groundbreaking new six-part, one-hour limited series UNIDENTIFIED: INSIDE AMERICA'S UFO INVESTIGATION, Elizondo is speaking out for the first time with Tom DeLonge, co-founder and President of To The Stars Academy of Arts & Science and Chris Mellon, former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense and Intelligence, to expose a series of startling encounters and embark on fascinating new investigations that will urge the public to ask questions and look for answers. The series will reveal newly authenticated evidence and footage, interviews from eyewitnesses and former military personnel who have never spoken out before, and extensive breakthroughs in understanding the technology behind these unknown phenomena in our skies.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Lost History
programme.desc: Host Brad Meltzer enlists America's help to find lost and stolen historical artifacts, which are going missing from museums and public collections at an alarming rate. The most shocking missing item of all: the iconic Ground Zero Flag, raised by firefighters on 9/11. A few hours after it was raised, this sacred relic simply disappeared. Then, a multi-million dollar collection of jewel-encrusted swords and daggers that once belonged to Harry Truman is stolen, in a daring daylight heist. Plus: the incredible story of John Dillinger's Tommy gun, stolen from a police station before becoming his favorite weapon, goes missing for decades.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: A gripping story about a day in the life of two rival gang members, one a Crip, the other a Blood, who also happens to be cousins, Curtis and Terrance. Curtis, an unreformed ex-inmate who was just recently released from jail, ask Terrance to drive him to a job interview, stopping at the bank on the way. Unbeknownst to Terrance, Curtis goes into the bank, robs it! Terrance drive's off, confused and scared, does whatever Curtis says as they end up with two kidnapped college cheerleaders as their hostages.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: Engineering has built our modern world. Everything from skyscrapers to roads and air travel exist because of advances in engineering. What happens when engineering goes horribly wrong? Engineering Disasters goes beyond the headlines to uncover what really happened in the most notorious engineering accidents. What caused an outdoor stage to collapse in Indiana, killing seven? How did a collection of classic Corvettes disappear right out of thin air? Why did a plane's fuselage rip open in mid-flight? What was behind the collapse of a domed stadium? Each hour long episode combines expert and eyewitness interviews, state of the art graphics and dramatic 'moment of disaster' footage to tell the story behind the world's most terrifying engineering disasters.

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: In Mexico, explorers use a sacred ancient Mayan temple code to search for an occult underworld engineered in the depths of the earth--a mysterious site where no TV cameras have ever ventured. In Britain, investigators uncover the secret technologies behind a life size statue of Jesus Christ that miraculously came to life. Weapons experts reveal the science that saved a holy military order from certain annihilation in the bloodiest siege in history. In Greece, archaeologists solve the mystery of the oracle of the dead; an eerie sanctuary where flying ghosts appeared from the depths of hell.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Lost History
programme.desc: American history is vanishing one artifact at a time. Some of our most important historical and cultural treasures have been lost or stolen. Every year, dozens of treasures, from George Washington's teeth to the Apollo 11 moon landing tapes to even the iconic ground zero flag from the September 11 attacks, vanish from the shelves of famous museums, government archives and private collections. Now, host Brad Meltzer leads the hunt to return these treasures to their rightful owners–the American people. Many lost artifacts are circulating on the black market, but dozens of previously lost objects have already been found—by ordinary citizens—in attics, at garage sales and even online. Brad will also enlist the help of viewers, giving the public the chance to help restore our history too.

programme.title: Engineering an Empire
programme.desc: In an era long passed, mighty empires were forged from nothing and rose to the heights of power. Join host Peter Weller, an actor and a professor at Syracuse University as he travels the world to show the engineering feats that gave rise to some of the greatest civilizations known to man. From Rome to the Pharaohs' Egypt, from Greece to Carthage, from the Aztecs to the Maya and more, this new program from the History Channel uses computer graphics to explore the architectural, political and cultural glory of the world's greatest empires.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares.
